narrative: A hacked friend contact messages you to vote for them in a contest.

message.body: Hey!! I'm in the top 3 for the National Art Contest win ₹50k prize! Can you please vote for me real quick? Click http://artcontest-vote-verify.com and log in with your account to confirm vote!

evidence.label: Credential Request
evidence.value: Requires logging in with personal social credentials to vote

evidence.label: Friend Profile Name
evidence.value: Matches classmate's real profile name and photo

evidence.label: Direct Voice Call to Priya
evidence.value: Priya answers call and says her account was hacked 1 hour ago.

consequence_text.safe: Calling your friend out-of-band revealed her account was compromised.
consequence_text.unsafe: Entering credentials on contest voting links hands account control to hijackers.

teaching_point: Contest voting links sent from friend accounts are common social engineering vectors.
